title: On the Lack of Periodicity of Walker Satellite Constellation Routing Tables
summary: In a referential that rotates with Earth, the dynamics of the configurations of satellites in a Delta Walker constellation can be analyzed as a dynamical system as a function of a translation on the torus. This paper extends this type of analysis to routing over a Walker constellation, leveraging fixed ground relays. It considers any deterministic, time-invariant routing rule on such a collection of satellites and relays.
